actions.name: fiendish restoration
actions.desc: If it dies, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} returns to life in [[/r 1d6]] days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three attacks, using [[/item .mmBite0000000000]] or [[/item .mmNecroticRay000]] in any combination.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMinorIllus]{Minor Illusion}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWaterBreat]{Water Breathing} 2/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{Dimension Door}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHoldPerson]{Hold Person} (level 3), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLightningB]{Lightning Bolt} (level 4)
